subject.title: [Bug] v2026.5.22 启动后 Gateway CPU 持续 100%+，导致请求延迟飙升 50-100 倍

question: Should OpenClaw make provider-auth startup prewarm default-off while keeping explicit opt-in and auth-failure rewarm behavior?
rationale: The issue is a credible shipped regression and the code path is clear, but the remaining fix changes auth-provider startup readiness semantics and is already carried by a maintainer-labeled draft PR.

options.title: Land default-off startup prewarm
options.body: Review and land the existing narrow PR if maintainers accept lazy or failure-triggered provider-auth warming as the normal startup behavior.

options.title: Keep eager startup prewarm
options.body: Reject the default-off PR and document the current environment opt-out plus any expected startup cost for larger provider setups.

options.title: Design a different startup contract
options.body: Hold the issue open for a different explicit startup mode or diagnostic path if neither eager nor default-off warming is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Land default-off startup prewarm
recommendation.body: Review and land the existing narrow PR if maintainers accept lazy or failure-triggered provider-auth warming as the normal startup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The active PR for this exact startup-prewarm default decision is assigned to and authored by vincentkoc.
